parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
{{Needed|[[Slash weapon]] or [[knife]] if using [[Lever (Edgeville)|Edgeville]] or [[Lever (Ardougne)|Ardougne lever]]
}}

'''{{Colour|red|Beware}}: caution must be taken not only getting to the [[Mage arena]] but also during the miniquest. PKers are able to attack you while you are fighting [[Kolodion]].'''

{{Checklist|
*Travel to the [[Mage Arena bank]].
**If using the [[Lever (Edgeville)|Edgeville]] or [[Lever (Ardougne)|Ardougne levers]], bring something to [[slash]] the [[web]] with and bring nothing or low-risk items, and go to the [[Mage Arena bank]] located in level 53 [[Wilderness]].
**If available, using [[Ice Plateau Teleport|Ice Plateau]] (53 Wilderness) or [[Ghorrock Teleport|Ghorrock Teleports]] (45 Wilderness) are other quick methods of travel.
*Gear up in low-risk items in preparation for the fight, which will take place in deep Wilderness.
*Talk to [[Kolodion]] at the [[Mage Arena bank]]. {{Chat option|1Can I fight here?|1Yes indeedy.|1Okay, let's fight.}} ('''{{Colour|red|Warning}}: You will be teleported into the arena which is in level 54 wilderness.''')
*Kill [[Kolodion]]'s 5 forms. ('''Note:''' You may safespot Kolodion by trapping him behind a skeleton within the arena.)
*Step-into [[Sparkling pool]] north-east.
*Go north and pray-at the [[Statue of Saradomin]], [[Statue of Guthix|Guthix]], or [[Statue of Zamorak|Zamorak]].
*Pick up the corresponding [[Saradomin cape|Saradomin]], [[Guthix cape|Guthix]], or [[Zamorak cape]].
*Go south and talk to the [[Chamber Guardian]] to receive the corresponding [[Saradomin staff|Saradomin]], [[Guthix staff|Guthix]], or [[Zamorak staff]].
*Step-into [[Sparkling pool]] south.
*Talk to [[Kolodion]].
*'''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''}}
